Since the day you left, brother, nothing feels unchanged. You were thunder in the silence, a line in the storm, a fighter with a heart, always breaking the norm. You told the kids to dream, to never back down. And now we stand here without you around. We will miss you, Hulk Hogan, every single day. From the battles in the ring to the words you'd say, we will miss that spirit so bold and so true. The world won't be the same without you. We will miss you, Hulk Hogan. More than words can show. But your light still shines even as you go. Forever our champion. Forever our friend. This ain't goodbye. It's just till we meet again. You lifted more than weights. You lifted broken souls. Taught us all that courage means chasing every goal. From Wrestlemania lights to hospital halls, you gave your all, stood strong through it all.
